target: Wire a real gh-backed GitHub adapter for the orchestrator PR queue/readiness commands and the approval-gated `pr comment` mutation
invariants: PR list/queue/readiness reads are T0/T1 — no GitHub mutations on the read paths
`pr comment` is T5 — requires typed approval phrase + receipt; refusal must be deterministic
No auto-merge logic is added in this packet
No branch push automation is added in this packet
Adapter must fail closed when `gh` CLI is unavailable or unauthenticated
Adapter must respect a per-repo allowlist (defaults to the current repo only)

commit.message: feat(orchestrator): live gh-backed PR readiness adapter

pr.title: feat(orchestrator): live gh-backed PR readiness adapter
pr.body: Replaces the caller-supplied `--pr <number>:<checks>:<proof>` string parser with a real gh-backed adapter for orchestrator pr queue/readiness/comment. Reads stay T0/T1. The `pr comment` mutation stays gated behind the existing typed approval phrase. Refuses cleanly when gh is missing/unauthenticated.

steps.task: Design GithubAdapter interface: list_prs(repo, filters), get_pr(repo, number), get_checks(repo, number), get_reviews(repo, number), get_branch_age(repo, number), find_proof_path(repo, number), comment(repo, number, body, approval_id).
validation: Interface is read/write-split: list_prs..find_proof_path are pure read; comment is the only mutation surface.

steps.task: Implement the adapter via `gh api` and `gh pr` subprocess calls (no direct httpx to GitHub).
validation: Subprocess invocations are deterministic and shell-escaped.
Adapter fails closed with a typed error when `gh` is absent or not authenticated.
Per-repo allowlist (config/orchestrator/github_allowlist.yaml) is enforced before any call.

steps.task: Replace the caller-supplied `--pr` parser in build_pr_queue() with a classifier that consumes the adapter's read output and emits MERGEABLE/BLOCKED/STALE/REDUNDANT/DANGEROUS/NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE.
validation: Classification matrix tests cover every state using mocked adapter responses.

steps.task: Route `pr comment` writes through the existing typed-approval phrase + approval-policy check; emit a receipt on success.
validation: Tests assert that the read commands NEVER call adapter.comment().
Successful comment writes emit a receipt with canonical_writer = github-api.

steps.task: Update `orchestrator pr queue`, `pr readiness`, and `pr comment` to use the adapter; the legacy `--pr <n>:<checks>:<proof>` flag stays as a fallback for offline use and is documented as deprecated.
validation: CLI tests cover online (mocked) and offline (--pr fallback) paths.
Deprecation warning is emitted on legacy --pr usage.

steps.task: Emit proof bundle at proof/dmx-orch-integration/TP-DMX-ORCH-013-LIVE/PROOF.json with the full validations array, not_run (live GitHub calls in CI), residual_risks, and rollback_plan.
validation: Proof status is READY_FOR_REVIEW only after the full PR-readiness classification matrix passes.
